title: Additional devices.
officialText:
Appliances requiring a controlled chimney draft shall be permitted to be equipped with a listed
double-acting barometric-draft regulator installed and adjusted in accordance with the manufacturers’ instructions. Barometric-
draft regulators shall be equipped with a thermal safety (spill) switch installed in accordance with its listing and the manufacturer’s
instructions.
